Begin practical therapy that fits into the life you already have

I offer focused, evidence-informed therapy for anxiety, relationship strain, burnout, and life transitions. Sessions are collaborative, confidential, and paced to your readiness.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Call {{PHONE}}

{{THERAPIST_NAME}}, {{LICENSE}} — services available in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. Confidentiality is protected within clinical and legal limits. If you are in crisis, call local emergency services or the crisis line in your area.

How I hold space for you

Therapy should feel safe, purposeful, and practical. These guiding values shape every session.

  • Clear goals. We identify 1–3 priorities and check progress collaboratively.
  • Warm directness. Honest feedback offered with compassion.
  • Practical tools. Skills you can use between sessions.

Approaches I draw from

I blend modalities to meet where you are. Common techniques include:

  • Cognitive-behavioral interventions for managing unhelpful thoughts and patterns.
  • Mindfulness and somatic practices to reduce stress and ground the nervous system.
  • Relational work to explore patterns in partnerships and family systems.
  • Strength-based planning to support realistic, steady change.

Modalities: {{MODALITIES}}

Common hesitations — and what I hear back

  • "I don’t have time." Even brief, regular sessions can shift momentum. We’ll plan with your schedule.
  • "I’m not sure therapy will help." You can treat the first several sessions as an assessment: if it’s not a good fit, we’ll discuss options.
  • "I’m worried about privacy." Confidentiality is central; exceptions are limited by law and safety concerns, which I will explain clearly.

"I was skeptical, but concrete tools and a predictable plan helped me manage anxiety and return to things I’d stopped doing." — a client

If you have specific barriers (cost, childcare, transportation), mention them — I will work through options with you honestly.

Client reflections

"The structure and clear homework made therapy feel manageable — I began noticing small shifts within weeks." — former client
"I appreciated the directness and warmth. Sessions felt efficient and respectful of my time." — former client

Starter guide — a short workbook

A concise guide to begin applying coping skills and creating a one-page plan for change. Free to download when you subscribe.

I’ll only email resources related to beginning therapy and practical tools. You can unsubscribe any time.

Reach out confidentially

Use the form below or choose a direct contact method. I aim to reply within 48 business hours.

Book a session

Confidentiality note: Communications by email are not fully secure. By reaching out you consent to communication with this understanding. For urgent crises, call 911 or your local crisis line immediately.

Scope & boundaries: I provide psychotherapy and supportive counseling; I do not provide emergency services or prescribe medication. If you are seeking psychiatric medication management, I can collaborate with prescribers or refer you.

Licensed in {{STATE}}. Practice location: {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. All client information is kept confidential except where disclosure is required by law (e.g., imminent risk of harm, abuse). This site is for informational purposes and not a substitute for clinical evaluation.
